description: This file defines the ThermostatSchedule module, including data structures and algorithms for scheduling thermostat actions based on time and event patterns, with embedded JavaScript code for runtime behavior.

classes.name: WeekTime
classes.description: A class representing a scheduled time within a week, with methods to compare and manipulate weekly schedule instances.

classes.name: ScheduleMode
classes.description: A class encapsulating a collection of schedule conditions, with methods to process and determine current schedules based on time.

methods.name: WeekTime
methods.description: Constructor for creating a WeekTime instance based on a given object containing daysOfWeek and seconds.

methods.name: WeekTime.prototype.withDaysUpTo
methods.description: Returns a new WeekTime object that is constrained up to a specified weekTime.

methods.name: WeekTime.compare
methods.description: Static method to compare two WeekTime instances, considering days of the week and seconds.

methods.name: ScheduleMode
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ScheduleMode with a list of schedules.

methods.name: processSchedules
methods.description: Function to process and select the appropriate schedule based on current time.
